id: https://github.com/kaicreator-mm/tally
name: tally_software_engineering_knowledge_pof
title: Tally Software Engineering Knowledge — LinkML Proof-of-fit
description: >-
  Experimental model for source provenance, domain nodes, atomic claims and typed
  relationship assertions. This schema is a proof-of-fit fixture, not an adopted
  production ontology.
version: "0.1.0"
prefixes:
  linkml: https://w3id.org/linkml/
  se: https://github.com/kaicreator-mm/tally#
  schema: https://schema.org/
  dcterms: http://purl.org/dc/terms/
  prov: http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#
  rdf: http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#
  rdfs: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#
default_prefix: se
default_range: string
imports:
  - linkml:types

classes:
  Source:
    class_uri: se:Source
    description: A bibliographically identified source used by the corpus.
    slots:
      - id
      - title
      - source_class
      - official_url
      - edition
      - publication_date

  SourceLocator:
    class_uri: se:SourceLocator
    description: A precise location within a source that has been inspected.
    slots:
      - id
      - source_ref
      - locator_type
      - locator
      - verification_state
    unique_keys:
      source_and_locator:
        unique_key_slots:
          - source_ref
          - locator

  Evidence:
    class_uri: se:Evidence
    description: A source-grounded observation or paraphrase with an exact locator.
    slots:
      - id
      - evidence_type
      - source_locator_ref
      - paraphrase
      - context
      - extraction_status

  DomainNode:
    class_uri: se:DomainNode
    description: A node in one explicitly identified domain-taxonomy view.
    slots:
      - id
      - label
      - view_id
      - source_ref
      - source_locator_ref
      - taxonomy_ref

  KnowledgeClaim:
    class_uri: se:KnowledgeClaim
    description: An atomic, scoped and reviewable statement about the domain.
    slots:
      - id
      - claim_type
      - statement
      - scope
      - applicability
      - assumptions
      - limitations
      - review_status
      - source_refs
      - taxonomy_refs
      - domain_node_refs

  RelationshipAssertion:
    class_uri: rdf:Statement
    description: A typed, reviewable assertion between identified graph nodes.
    slots:
      - id
      - subject_ref
      - predicate
      - object_ref
      - object_kind
      - evidence_ref
      - status

  ClaimBundle:
    class_uri: se:ClaimBundle
    description: A review bundle for one claim, its domain-node context and assertions.
    slots:
      - id
      - claim
      - domain_nodes
      - relationship_assertions

  KnowledgeCorpus:
    class_uri: se:KnowledgeCorpus
    tree_root: true
    description: A self-contained knowledge graph fixture with canonical records.
    slots:
      - id
      - title
      - corpus_status
      - sources
      - source_locators
      - evidence_records
      - domain_nodes
      - knowledge_claims
      - relationship_assertions

slots:
  id:
    identifier: true
    required: true
    range: string
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    description: Stable identifier for the record.
  title:
    required: true
    range: string
    slot_uri: schema:name
  source_class:
    required: true
    range: SourceClass
  official_url:
    range: string
    slot_uri: schema:url
  edition:
    range: string
  publication_date:
    range: string
  source_ref:
    required: true
    range: Source
    inlined: false
    slot_uri: dcterms:source
  locator_type:
    required: true
    range: LocatorType
  locator:
    required: true
    range: string
  verification_state:
    required: true
    range: VerificationState
  evidence_type:
    required: true
    range: EvidenceType
  source_locator_ref:
    required: true
    range: SourceLocator
    inlined: false
    slot_uri: prov:wasDerivedFrom
  paraphrase:
    required: true
    range: string
    slot_uri: schema:description
  context:
    range: string
  extraction_status:
    required: true
    range: EvidenceStatus
  label:
    required: true
    range: string
    slot_uri: rdfs:label
  view_id:
    required: true
    range: string
  taxonomy_ref:
    required: true
    range: string
  claim_type:
    required: true
    range: ClaimType
  statement:
    required: true
    range: string
    slot_uri: schema:text
  scope:
    required: true
    range: string
  applicability:
    range: string
  assumptions:
    range: string
    multivalued: true
  limitations:
    range: string
    multivalued: true
  review_status:
    required: true
    range: ClaimStatus
  source_refs:
    range: Source
    multivalued: true
    inlined: false
    slot_uri: dcterms:source
  taxonomy_refs:
    range: string
    multivalued: true
  domain_node_refs:
    range: DomainNode
    multivalued: true
    inlined: false
  subject_ref:
    required: true
    range: KnowledgeClaim
    inlined: false
    slot_uri: rdf:subject
  predicate:
    required: true
    range: RelationshipPredicate
    slot_uri: rdf:predicate
  object_ref:
    required: true
    range: string
    slot_uri: rdf:object
  object_kind:
    required: true
    range: RelationshipObjectKind
  evidence_ref:
    range: Evidence
    inlined: false
    slot_uri: prov:wasDerivedFrom
  status:
    required: true
    range: RelationshipStatus
  corpus_status:
    required: true
    range: CorpusStatus
  claim:
    required: true
    range: KnowledgeClaim
    inlined: true
  domain_nodes:
    range: DomainNode
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  relationship_assertions:
    range: RelationshipAssertion
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  sources:
    range: Source
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  source_locators:
    range: SourceLocator
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  evidence_records:
    range: Evidence
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  knowledge_claims:
    range: KnowledgeClaim
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true

enums:
  SourceClass:
    permissible_values:
      PROFESSIONAL_BOK:
      CURRICULUM_FRAMEWORK:
      GOVERNMENT_FRAMEWORK:
  LocatorType:
    permissible_values:
      TITLE_PAGE:
      TABLE:
      SECTION:
      ABSTRACT:
  VerificationState:
    permissible_values:
      LOCATOR_VERIFIED:
      ABSTRACT_VERIFIED:
  EvidenceType:
    permissible_values:
      DIRECT_SOURCE_PARAPHRASE:
  EvidenceStatus:
    permissible_values:
      EXTRACTED_PENDING_REVIEW:
  ClaimType:
    permissible_values:
      TAXONOMY_STATEMENT:
  ClaimStatus:
    permissible_values:
      PENDING:
      PENDING_LIMITED_EVIDENCE:
  RelationshipPredicate:
    permissible_values:
      SUPPORTED_BY:
        meaning: se:SUPPORTED_BY
      INCLUDES:
        meaning: se:INCLUDES
  RelationshipObjectKind:
    permissible_values:
      EVIDENCE:
      DOMAIN_NODE:
  RelationshipStatus:
    permissible_values:
      PENDING:
  CorpusStatus:
    permissible_values:
      DRAFT_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW:
